correctness.rationale: For all \(r\ge2\), the characteristic-two path continuant identity proves that the length-\(2^r-1\) path adjacency has characteristic polynomial \(X^n\); a cyclic endpoint proves its only Jordan block is \(J_n(0)\). The rung adjacency is identity plus a square-zero block. Multiplication by \(x+y\) in \(\mathbb F_2[x,y]/(x^n,y^2)\) has kernel dimension two and nilpotence index \(n+1\), hence exact blocks \(J_{n+1}(0)\) and \(J_{n-1}(0)\). The direct matrix identity \(\Phi_3(T)=\operatorname{diag}(K,K)T\) and invertibility of \(T\) determine two cyclotomic cyclic factors. GCD multiplicities of \(X^t-1\) with \(\Phi_3\) powers give fixed spaces for all positive times; nested filtrations give all primitive counts. Standalone matrix checks verify the formula for every time through the global order for \(n=3,7,15,31\); independent direct evolution exhausts all 4096 binary states at \(n=3\). These finite checks are corroborative. All universal quantifiers and field extensions follow from the proof.

value.rationale: The primitive temporal-orbit population is a natural dynamical invariant of a reversible finite lattice wave. Open width-two ladders are a standard bounded-width graph geometry; dyadic lengths isolate a genuine Frobenius resonance of the path operator, not an arbitrary small numerical slice. Rung coupling converts path-like dynamics to two unequal cyclotomic Jordan chains and the sharp clock \(3\cdot2^r\). The result determines all fixed-point counts, realised primitive periods and orbit counts for infinitely many rung lengths and every characteristic-two finite field. Generic reversibility, basic path polynomial identities and computational verification alone do not supply this structural classification.
